samples.summary: CLI docs export assumes docs images are publicly readable; share-uploaded docs images are workspace-scoped and get silently dropped
samples.evidence: `createImageFetcher` documents and implements the assumption that "Backend's `GET /images/:id` is publicly readable, so we don't attach an Authorization header" (packages/cli/src/docs/image-fetcher.ts:737-741), and `packages/cli/src/commands/docs.ts:333` builds it with `{ serverBase }` only — no credential of any kind. Until this change every docs inline image lived on the unauthenticated `/images/:id` route (see the now-deleted comment in shared-document.tsx and `document-copy.service.ts:432`). After this change an image inserted through an editor share link is stored at `/api/v1/workspaces/{ws}/images/{id}` (image-share-upload.controller.ts:117-121), which `ApiV1ImageReadController.assertCanRead` refuses for an unauthenticated caller. `packages/cli/src/docs/pdf-export.ts:118` and `docx-export.ts:41` pass `reportSkippedImage`/`onImageError`, so the export does not fail — it emits a stderr warning and produces a PDF/DOCX with the image missing. `wafflebase docs export` therefore silently loses exactly the images this feature adds. Fix belongs in the CLI fetcher (attach the configured API key for first-party workspace-image URLs), not in the new controller.

samples.summary: Copy service comment still asserts docs images are always bucket-root, so the re-host pass "normally finds nothing"
samples.evidence: `document-copy.service.ts:432-437` states "`doc` images are uploaded to the bucket root (`docsImageUploader` → `POST /images`), so there is normally nothing here to re-host. The pass runs anyway…". With the new share-token upload route, docs routinely hold workspace-scoped URLs, so this pass is now load-bearing for docs (and, for cross-workspace copies, subject to `MAX_REHOSTED_IMAGES` and the `onFailure` policy). The code still works — `collectImageRefs` is structure-agnostic — but the comment now describes the old contract and would mislead the next change to this branch.

samples.summary: Design-doc route table still lists `doc` as using only the unauthenticated bucket-root image route
samples.evidence: docs/design/template-gallery.md:175-176 tabulates image routes: `postSharedImage → POST /images` … "thumbnails; `doc` (packages/frontend/src/app/docs/export-utils.ts)", and the workspace-scoped row lists only `sheet`, `board`, `note` and native `slides`. After this change docs can also hold workspace-scoped images (uploaded via `POST /api/v1/shared/images`), so this table — the reference the copy/re-host and gallery work is derived from — is out of step.

samples.summary: Docs clipboard/markdown paths carry the raw workspace image URL, so share-uploaded images break when copied into another workspace or exported as markdown
samples.evidence: `sanitizeImageData` (packages/docs/src/view/clipboard.ts:116) copies `src` verbatim, and `packages/docs/src/serialize/markdown.ts` emits it as-is. Previously any docs image src was on the unauthenticated `/images/:id` route, so a paste into a doc in a different workspace, or an exported markdown file, still rendered. A share-link-uploaded image is `/api/v1/workspaces/{ws}/images/{id}`, which `ApiV1ImageReadController.assertCanRead` 403s for a member of any other workspace and for anyone without a token. Same characteristic sheets/slides already have, so this may be accepted — but it is a new way for docs content to stop rendering after a copy.

verdict.reason: All claimed evidence checks out in the repo. image-fetcher.ts:737-741 does state and implement the "GET /images/:id is publicly readable, so no Authorization header" assumption, and a grep of the whole file finds no credential attached on any hop (issue/planHop, 793-815). docs.ts:333-335 builds the fetcher with `{ serverBase }` only, even though the CLI holds an api key (config.ts:11,79) that http-client.ts:204-207 attaches to every other request. Share-link-inserted docs images are stored at the workspace-scoped URL (image-share-upload.controller.ts:112-115, persisted into the CRDT by image-insert.ts:40-48), and image-read.controller.ts:40-63,92-130 refuses an anonymous, header-less GET (no api key, no member JWT, no ?token=). shared-document.tsx:872-876 independently confirms owner-inserted docs images stay on the legacy public /images/:id route while share-link ones are workspace-scoped — i.e. this is a new URL shape the CLI consumer was not updated for. Because pdf-export.ts:118 and docx-export.ts:41 pass reportSkippedImage, and pdf-image-painter.ts:100-101 / docx-exporter.ts:481-482 swallow the error when a reporter is given, the export does not fail: it prints one stderr line (image-fetcher.ts:727-730) and emits a PDF/DOCX with the image missing. That is a cross-package consumer of the changed contract left silently skipping work — in-lane for blast-radius and major. No guard elsewhere makes it unreachable.
